verdict.rationale: Authy is a TOTP authenticator, so team sharing of TOTP secrets is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows syncing one user's 2FA tokens across that user's own devices, plus device management for the same account. Nothing shows shared vaults, collections, team membership or per-member access control.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
